title: Integral continuous-coefficient pullback preserves flatness
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface]. For prime ℓ, a normed extension E of ℚ_ℓ, and every scheme map f:X→Y, the actual ordinary pullback (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧ preserves flat internal modules.

proof.text: Identify extension along the coefficient-pullback isomorphism with restriction along its inverse, using Mod.extendScalarsIsoComapInv and whiskering with inverse image on module objects. Apply inverseImageModule_preservesFlat and invariance of flatness under isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: A4: specialize inverseImageModule_preservesFlat via the explicit extension/restriction-along-inverse isomorphism; no monoidal pullback construction is used.
